subject: general
question: Which of the following 'V' blocks will have one 'V' groove and two grooves (slots) on 5 either side for clamping in two positions?
solution:
The correct answer is __Single level double groove 'V' block**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Single level double groove 'V' block__ is designed with one 'V' groove and two grooves (slots) on either side for clamping.
 
• It is used for holding cylindrical objects securely during inspection or machining.
 
• The grooves on either side provide flexibility in clamping the block in two different positions.
 
• This design ensures stability and precision during operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Matched pair 'V' block:**

 
 
• Usually used in pairs for holding long cylindrical objects.
 
• Does not have double grooves for clamping in two positions.
 
 
 
• **Single level single groove 'V' block:**
 
 
• Has only one groove and is not designed for dual clamping positions.
 
 
 
• **Double level single groove 'V' block:**
 
 
• Features two levels for holding objects at different heights but lacks double grooves for clamping on either side.
